notes: Raw category divergence is a taxonomy diagnostic, not equivalent to a canonical false positive; grounded aliases may be permitted. Raw proposals without gold remain visible even when validation rejects them.
The final gate evaluates independently validated canonical claims; hybrid fallback does not change the reported LLM-only result.
No-claim denominators are undefined precision, not 0% correctness. Categories fewer than five sources support counts only.
V3 interrupted-case latency excluded because the same cached actual response was replayed. Original failure and recovery instrumentation are retained.
